entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. My order number is VF886-01.

I can certainly look into that for you. One moment while I pull up that order... Okay, I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on January 5th. To get started, could you tell me a little more about the problem? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's not broken. It's just... hard to use.
I see. What specifically about it did you find difficult?
The whole interface is confusing. I read the user manual, but it didn't help. Frankly, I just expected more from a VeloFit product. I want to send it back.
I understand. Let me just check the policy for you. Okay, I see you received the item 23 days ago.
And you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return and full refund for you right now. I'll just email you a prepaid shipping label.
Oh. Fine. I guess that's something.

Okay, I've just sent that email to the address on file. You should receive it within the next few minutes. Just print the label, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Whatever. Just make sure the email actually shows up.
It will. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
